proof_equivalent_invariant.statement: minimal swaps recursively split original cycles; scored equal-residue transpositions are exactly a monochromatic noncrossing forest. Any such forest can be extended to a noncrossing spanning tree and realized as a minimal factorization.
proof_equivalent_invariant.reduction: maximum scored swaps on a cycle = cycle_length - minimum number of monochromatic blocks in a noncrossing partition
proof_equivalent_invariant.recurrence: dp[l][r]=min(1+dp[l+1][r], dp[l+1][k-1]+dp[k][r] for k>l with same residue)
